blocks.text:
Breakfast at the accommodation hotel, at the agreed time the journey to the Coffee Farm located in the municipality of Santa Rosa de Cabal begins. average of 1,500 meters above sea level in soils of the volcanic origin of the Central Cordillera of the Colombian Andes. The tour begins in the company of a local expert, taking tourists through explaining what the coffee process is like from sowing, selective manual harvesting, and pulping. After this, we will roast special coffee beans on a wood stove in the kitchen of the typical peasant house where we can have an authentic coffee experience. On the way, there are several stations with viewpoints, beautiful landscapes, and natural surroundings of the place while we enjoy a cup of coffee. Finally, we go to the innovative process of drying the coffee bean and then to the beneficiary, ending in the main house where we are fired with a delicious coffee lemonade. We will take our Delicious Typical lunch (Included), and later we will move to Termales de Santa Rosa de Cabal, we will enter the spa and have free time to enjoy the facilities of the place and take a comforting thermal bath. At the agreed time, return to the accommodation hotel. 

Duration: 08 hours, 

Includes: Private transportation - Guidance, landscaping in the Tambo de Santa Rosa - Interactive Coffee Process - Assistance by expert staff from the Hacienda - Hydration and snack, Lunch, tickets to the spa

If Termales de Santa Rosa de Cabal has no availability, the visit may be moved to another spa in Pereira, subject to availability.

Breakfast at the Hotel and transfer to the Matecaña International Airport to take a flight (not included) to the city of Cartagena. Assistance at the Rafael Núñez Airport, and Transfer to the Hotel to carry out the respective Check in, Accommodation. At 2:00 p.m., a panoramic tour of the residential neighborhoods of Bocagrande, Castillogrande, and Manga will begin. We will visit San Pedro Claver Church, we will continue to the San Felipe de Barajas Castle, the most important work of military engineering in Spain in America and that protected the city from pirate attacks. At the end of this visit, you will return to the hotel on Santander Avenue where you can see the bastions and walls of the historic center; Visit the Las Bóvedas artisan center, and in the afternoon return to the Hotel.

Includes: transportation, Guidance, Income, and Local medical assistance card.

Duration: 04 hours. - Days of Operation: Every day

* Note: for single occupancy in City Tour is shared and includes: Discover the magical history of Cartagena de Indias on a tour in air-conditioned transportation. Accompanied by a professional bilingual guide, our tour includes a panoramic visit to the bay of Cartagena, the Pegasos pier, the public clock tower until you reach the Manga neighborhood to appreciate the Moorish and Republican architecture and visit the imposing Fort San Felipe de Barajas. Immerse yourself in the charm of the historic and walled city center

walled city center, with stops for shopping for handicrafts and a walk through the streets and squares full of history, including the San Pedro Claver Church and the bastion of Santo Domingo.
